shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
ls"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log -5 --oneline --decorate
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"UsageMetadata|afterModelResponse|usage\" CHANGELOG.md src specs adrs | head -120
cat package.json
rg -n \"ToolRegistry|register\\(\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -50
sed -n '240,620p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -30
rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|repoint'
sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '180,235p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/[''^ ]+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec:" --glob '"'*.test.ts' . | head -80
node scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs 2>/dev/null | rg -n 'chatOrchestrator.*keeps the usage|\"spec\"' | head -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts && git commit -m "feat: aggregate hook usage across rounds" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [ "$(git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD)" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
